Benchmark.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 Security Technical Implementation Guide

Rule.title: RHEL 9 must require authentication to access single-user mode.
Rule.description: Single-user mode is used for recovery when the system detects an issue.
Rule.fixtext: Set a password for the root account.

check.check-content: Verify the rescue service requires authentication.

Rule.title: RHEL 9 must not have the telnet-server package installed.
Rule.description: Removing the telnet-server package removes an unencrypted remote access service.
